references.text: When the crowd saw Jesus' miracles, they exclaimed: 'A great prophet has arisen among us' ([ref:Luk 7:16|Luke 7:16]). The same kind of recognition of a prophet occurs when the Samaritan woman realizes that Jesus has supernatural knowledge about her life.

After the miracle of the loaves, the people said: 'This is truly the prophet who is to come into the world' ([ref:Joh 6:14|John 6:14]). Just like the Samaritan woman, the crowd also recognizes Jesus as a prophet based on his deeds.
Some in the crowd said: 'This is indeed the prophet' ([ref:Joh 7:40|John 7:40]). This shows that many recognized Jesus as a prophet, just as the Samaritan woman did.

The man born blind who was healed said about Jesus: 'He is a prophet' ([ref:Joh 9:17|John 9:17]). Both he and the Samaritan woman come to the same realization after personal experience with Jesus' supernatural power.

The travelers on the road to Emmaus described Jesus as 'a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people' ([ref:Luk 24:19|Luke 24:19]). Jesus was widely recognized as a prophet, consistent with the woman's confession.

Moses promised: 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people' ([ref:5 Mos 18:15|Deut 18:15]). The Samaritan woman's recognition of Jesus as a prophet points to the fulfillment of this promise.

The woman went into the town and said: 'Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?' ([ref:Joh 4:29|John 4:29]). Her understanding develops from 'prophet' (v. 19) to the possibility that Jesus is the Messiah.

When Jesus showed that he knew Nathanael before they had met, Nathanael exclaimed: 'Rabbi, you are the Son of God' ([ref:Joh 1:48-49|John 1:48-49]). Jesus' supernatural knowledge led Nathanael to faith, just as it also led the Samaritan woman to recognize him as a prophet.

The Pharisee Simon thought: 'If this man were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him' ([ref:Luk 7:39|Luke 7:39]). In contrast to Simon, who doubted Jesus' prophetic insight, the Samaritan woman recognized exactly that insight when Jesus revealed her life story.
